correctness.rationale: An exact constant-coefficient ODE gives the unique attracting equilibrium. Symbolic independent algebra confirms its derivative factorization Q(x^p)/(x^2(1+x^p)^2) with discriminant q[q(p-1)^2-4p], including positive roots, all endpoints, unique threshold-crossing counts, and the critical non-sign-changing tangent. Root expansion yields square-root splitting and integration yields a three-halves height gap. The freshly authored standalone verify.py passed 21,781 supplementary assertions (finite tests are not the proof). All oxygen interpretations explicitly require positive predicted concentration.

value.rationale: Shelf-sea observations explicitly establish that mixing ventilates bottom waters while also supplying organic material for remineralization, generating a concrete competing-mechanism mathematical question. The theorem provides a necessary-and-sufficient all-parameter criterion, explicit turning locations, exact three-crossing oxygen-threshold windows, and universal critical onset exponents; the motivated phase boundary is useful even though the precise sink law is uncalibrated.
